cleaner.label: Kotlin/Native
cleaner.description: Components and dependencies downloaded by Kotlin/Native into the .konan folder. Does not touch projects.

option.label: Kotlin/Native data
option.description: Removes the downloaded Kotlin/Native compiler, its dependencies (such as LLVM) and the compile caches.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next native build: a long operation that needs the network. Close Gradle and IDEs before cleaning.
